description: Today's model spend (UTC day), the daily bucket in force and the state (active | suspended) of every personal access token of yours, as /settings/tokens/spend shows it. Canary tokens are not listed: they never authenticate. Needs `user` scope. Returns {platformDefaultCents, tokens:[{tokenId, name, tokenPrefix, spentTodayCents, bucketCents (0 = no bucket), bucketSource: own|default, state, suspendedAt, suspendedReason, suspendedSpentCents}]}.
name: gluecron_list_token_spend
